definition: the vast body of salt water covering most of Earth
sentence: Ace read that the Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.

definition: a continuous flow of water in the sea
sentence: A warm ocean current carried the raft north.

definition: the force pressing on something, often measured in Pascals
sentence: Water pressure rises as you dive deeper.

definition: the natural home of a plant or animal
sentence: Coral reefs are a rich habitat for fish.

definition: tiny drifting organisms that many sea animals eat
sentence: Whales filter plankton from the water.

definition: a vessel that can travel underwater
sentence: The research submarine mapped the trench.

definition: the land along the edge of the sea
sentence: Canada's coastline is one of the longest in the world.

definition: the upward force that makes objects float
sentence: Buoyancy helps a life jacket keep you afloat.

definition: a very deep part of the ocean
sentence: Creatures in the abyss live in near darkness.

definition: a system that uses sound waves to find objects underwater
sentence: Scientists used sonar to locate the wreck.
